# `x4xref`

```text
usage: x4xref [-h] [--version] {build,who-calls,who-listens,cue} ...

Cross-index of MD/aiscript actions, events, and cue edges.

positional arguments:
  {build,who-calls,who-listens,cue}
    build               (re)build the index over base+DLC+installed mods
    who-calls           list every place an action element appears
    who-listens         list every cue reacting to an event_* condition
    cue                 where a cue is defined, signalled, cancelled

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

## `x4xref build`

```text
usage: x4xref build [-h] [--reference REFERENCE] [--ext-dir EXT_DIR] [--out OUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reference REFERENCE
                        unpacked base+DLC tree ($X4_REFERENCE)
  --ext-dir EXT_DIR     extensions dir (default: game-root from _registry)
  --out OUT             TSV output path (default: dev\_registry\md_xref.tsv)
```

## `x4xref who-calls`

```text
usage: x4xref who-calls [-h] [--tsv TSV] [--limit LIMIT] name

positional arguments:
  name           the action/event name (e.g. set_object_min_hull)

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --tsv TSV      index path (default: dev\_registry\md_xref.tsv)
  --limit LIMIT  max occurrences shown per source, 0 = no cap (default: 20)
```
